In case any readers are unaware, the Koehler Method is the German method f dog training. It’s not a reward based method, except that your hands are rewards, your feet are for correction, and I don’t mean you kick the dog. You have to see it to understand. It’s not mean, it is ALL BUSINESS. You train your dog to obey quickly with one command, not two, three, etc..

There are three levels of Koehler Dog training. Obedience, Home and Family Protection, and Police Dog Training—meaning it is the same method as all military, all law enforcement K-9 dogs are trained. It’s very effective, and if you do your homework as instructed, very fast.
